name: Teen Art Cooperative
what_you_do: Meet weekly at the museum to meet artists. You take field trips to local art spaces and learn about creative jobs. You also plan a public event made by teens for teens.
who_can_apply: Anyone enrolled in high school (grades 9 to 12) in the greater Pittsburgh region. Teens fill out their own application.
pay_detail: Free to join. No pay or stipend is mentioned.
duration: Thursdays 4 to 6 pm, October to May, with a winter break (2025 to 2026 schedule)
deadline_text: The 2025-26 call closed Sept 15, 2025 and the first session was Oct 9, 2025. The 2026-27 call was not found on the page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. It is linked from the museum page that asks for applicants. Applicants heard back in a few days. Send questions to Laurie Barnes, Education Director, at lbarnes@mattress.org.
notes: This is a high-commitment program: you are expected to come most Thursdays. The 2026-27 call was not found on the pages read.The museum is at 509 Jacksonia St, Pittsburgh, PA 15212.
